state.task: Configure data retention for the analytics warehouse according to the current retention policy.

current_context.body: Retention (policy RP-4 §2): raw event data is deleted after 30 days; aggregated reports are kept for 2 years.
Exception (RP-4 §2.3): records under legal hold are never deleted while the hold is active, regardless of age.
EU accounts (RP-4 §5): deletion requests must be completed within 30 days of receipt.
History: until March the raw-event window was 90 days (RP-3).

proposed_context.body: Retention (RP-4 §2, §2.3): raw event data is deleted after 30 days regardless of age; aggregated reports are kept for 2 years.
EU accounts (RP-4 §5): deletion requests must be completed within 30 days of receipt.
History: until March the raw-event window was 90 days (RP-3).

instructions.question: Does the proposed context drop, or mark as finished, an obligation, requirement, exception, open question or unresolved item that the current context still treats as active, when neither the current context nor the update says it is finished, superseded or no longer needed?
instructions.scope: Compare state.current_context (the working context before the rewrite) with state.proposed_context (the replacement). state.task is the task the context serves and state.update is already released information that may justify changes (empty if none).

criteria.true: Yes if an item that is still active in the current context is missing from the proposed context, or is now described as done, closed, answered or no longer applicable, and neither the current context nor the update supports that. This includes losing an exception or condition attached to a requirement that is kept.
criteria.false: No if every active item is still present, possibly paraphrased, shortened or merged; if removed items were superseded, completed, duplicated or closed according to the current context or the update; or if historical information is kept as history. A shorter context is not by itself a loss.

instructions.question: Does the proposed context state a value, number, limit, condition, status or relationship differently from the current context, without the update or the current context supporting the change?
instructions.scope: Compare state.current_context (the working context before the rewrite) with state.proposed_context (the replacement). state.task is the task the context serves and state.update is already released information that may justify changes (empty if none).

criteria.true: Yes if a value, threshold, amount, date, percentage, status, scope or which-applies-to-what relationship differs from the current context and the update does not justify the new version.
criteria.false: No if values, conditions and statuses mean the same (wording may differ), or if every difference is justified by the update or by the current context itself.

instructions.question: Does the proposed context remove the evidence reference supporting a claim it keeps, or attach a kept claim to a different reference than the current context did?
instructions.scope: Compare state.current_context (the working context before the rewrite) with state.proposed_context (the replacement). state.task is the task the context serves and state.update is already released information that may justify changes (empty if none).

criteria.true: Yes if a claim that remains in the proposed context had a source reference (file:line, document section, ticket, dashboard, link or citation) in the current context and that reference is now missing, or the claim now cites a different reference without the update supporting it.
criteria.false: No if kept claims keep their references (possibly reformatted or merged), if a claim and its reference were removed together, or if a reference changed in a way the update supports.
